description:
Exposes Oura Ring health data as read-only agent tools.
Covers daily sleep, readiness, activity, stress, resilience, SpO2, heart rate,
workouts, sessions, tags, VO2 max, cardiovascular age, battery level, and personal info.

token.description: Oura API bearer token: an OAuth2 access token from a registered app at cloud.ouraring.com (personal access tokens were deprecated in Dec 2025; previously issued ones still work). Grants read-only access to the token owner's data. Falls back to the ROCKETRIDE_OURA_TOKEN environment variable when empty.
